id: Jagoan baru: Sri (cangkul, sapuan lebar), Ujang (lari cepat, Jurus Ojol Ngebut naik motor), Mak Inah (pukulan berat, lempar jala yang menahan musuh)
Sri terbuka setelah Stage 1, Ujang setelah Stage 2, Mak Inah setelah Stage 3 — pilih di Pilih Jagoan
Main berdua di satu komputer: Pemain 2 pakai numpad (Enter untuk ikut) atau gamepad ke-2
Kalau satu pemain habis nyawa, tekan Pukul untuk lanjut selama temanmu masih bertarung
en: New heroes: Sri (hoe, wide sweeps), Ujang (fast dashes, Full Throttle motorbike charge), Mak Inah (heavy hits, a net throw that holds enemies)
Sri unlocks after Stage 1, Ujang after Stage 2, Mak Inah after Stage 3 — pick them in Character Select
Two players on one computer: Player 2 uses the numpad (Enter to join) or a second gamepad
If one player runs out of lives, press Punch to continue while your partner fights on
